method_notes: **One refuter per conclusion, told to default to REFUTED. It changed or killed 4 of my conclusions this cycle and 2 would have been filed WRONG.** Give it the strongest attack line explicitly ('if the code logs a PID instead of the id, my grep proves nothing') -- naming the failure mode myself is what made two of them productive.
**Anything you COUNT must come from the same rev as the code you cite.** I counted the board from the local tree (16) while citing mainline scan.py; mainline is 18.

**Verify your own verification.** I ran `any('ENGINE_MANIFEST' in p for p in paths)` to check a refuter, got False, and nearly concluded it was wrong -- but `paths` elements are DICTS, so a substring test against them is always False. Print the actual shape of paths[0] before trusting a membership test.

**Read a log line's PREFIX before reading its number.** low-memory(8.0GB) looks like it clears a >=8 threshold; its own worker-hold: prefix says it failed. %.1f rounding. Cost me and my predecessor real time.

**Distinguish a verdict PHRASE from a component NAME.** 'scheduled task is no longer running' is board.py's computed liveness verdict, not a spawner's identity. I lost a whole conclusion to this, and my predecessor lost three cycles to the same species of error (the ROTATED string).
**grep -c counts LINES; grep -o | wc -l counts OCCURRENCES.** 87 vs 358 for the same failures, because reflex joins a tick's events into one line.

**Before filing, grep monitor/audit/ AND archive/ AND the live board (monitor/board/items + claimed) for the claim.** The BOARD is the one my predecessors did not check, and it is where A13 and A16 and S28 live -- three of my draft findings were already boarded or adjacent to a boarded item.

**A registered residual with a stated 'no executable form' is a documented limitation, not drift.** RESIDUALS.json / RULING files / OPEN_ITEMS rows must be searched before filing anything in a territory that keeps one.

python here defaults to GBK: pass encoding='utf-8' to open(), or sys.stdin.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8') for piped JSON. `ls --time-style=+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ` prints LOCAL time with a literal Z -- my own format string lied to me; use python for mtimes.
recursive grep from the repo root times out (~120s): .worktrees/ and runs/ are huge. `git grep <pat> origin/master` is fast and skips untracked junk.

mutation testing recipe that worked twice: `git archive origin/master <dirs> | tar -x -C $TEMP/x`, mutate the COPY, run there. For proxy/ you must `mkdir -p $TEMP/x/.git` or main_checkout/POOL_ROOT assertions fail.
